goal: Build a small Expense Tracker using HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript only. Add an expense with a description, finite positive amount and category; display expenses, calculate the total, delete entries, and persist data using browser localStorage. Use a responsive desktop/mobile interface. No dependencies, backend, database, authentication, API keys or deployment. Return index.html, style.css, app.js and README.md with plain-English comments. Keep scope intentionally small. The independent Tester must supply new or meaningfully revised node:test verification files; Builder tests alone do not satisfy the testing gate. The Reviewer must inspect final implementation and recorded independent test evidence, without modifying code or claiming tests it did not run.
